At BeTranslated, we see your Dutch translation projects all the way through, from beginning to end, from the receipt of your documents, to their timely delivery.
Our project managers, all of whom are former translators, know the ins and outs of their trade. They will select the most qualified translators for your project, taking the greatest care with their selection process.
Dutch Translation Services
Translation between English and Dutch

Translate your content into Dutch and reach 24 million people
Some 24 million people in the world speak Dutch. This number jumps to 32 million if we take into account Afrikaans speakers.
In Europe, Dutch is one of the official languages in the Netherlands and Belgium, and is therefore one of the official languages of the European Union as well.
It is a main language for the medical, construction, and IT sectors. Professional translators are an important link between English and Dutch-speaking companies.
Did you know that the Netherlands is the UK’s third-largest trading partner, with the main imports to the UK from the Netherlands being refined oil, telecoms, pharmaceutical products, and office machinery?
Find out why you need our Dutch translation services for your professional documents.

Standard Dutch or Flemish?
Dutch is spoken in the Netherlands, in Belgium, in Suriname, Aruba, the Dutch Antilles, South Africa, and Indonesia.
Afrikaans is spoken in South Africa, Zimbabwe, and Namibia, and most Dutch speakers understand the language.
It is important, however, to know the difference between Standard Dutch and Flemish, spoken in Belgium and in French Flanders.
A Dutch speaker from Amsterdam might use expressions, pronunciation, or even vocabulary that sound slightly different from those used by someone from Antwerp, even though both are speaking Dutch.
These variations can affect how naturally your message is received by your target audience.
We at BeTranslated are linguists at heart, and we are experts in dealing with dialects, language variations, and cultural differences.

A responsive English to Dutch translation service
Do you want to translate content to or from Dutch? That makes perfect sense, but how should you proceed?
The translation market is vast, and there are countless translation providers, making it difficult to choose one that you can entrust with your project.
Be careful and don’t take this decision lightly. It is essential that you hand your documents over to a reliable and professional English-Dutch translator.
BeTranslated could be the perfect Dutch translation service provider for you. Request your free, no-obligation quote today.

Professional Dutch to English translators at your beck and call
Are you currently doing business, or planning to go into business with a company in a Dutch-speaking country?
Have you received documents in Dutch that you need urgently translated into English?
All commercial exchanges between countries are accompanied by official documents, proposals, and business offers that need to be professionally translated by experienced linguists.
BeTranslated relies on a network of professional translators that are ready to take on your translation project.
Our Dutch translators
Marianne
French and English into Dutch translator
With over 8 years working in the translation industry, Marianne is an experienced translator, whose native language is Dutch. She regularly translates from French and English into Dutch, specialising in the IT sector.
Sara
English and French into Dutch translator
Sara grew up in Flanders, Belgium, and graduated from VLEKHO Business School in Brussels in 2007. She translates from English and French into Dutch, working as both an in-house and freelance translator since 2008.
Stephanie
French, Italian, and English into Dutch translator
Stephanie gained her translation qualifications in 2000, and translates from French, Italian, and English, into her native Dutch. Translation for the ecological and social sector are among her extensive expertise.
